answer: Split-Key Attestation Prism.** Each identity's signing key is split across three independent witnesses drawn from disjoint pools; every action must carry fragments recombined at verification. An anchor record ties each fragment to a witness's own identity, so a cloned agent must recruit three fresh, unrelated witnesses per duplicate. At peak load the witness pool caps issuance, pushing attackers toward a zenith of coordination cost: each sybil needs its own witness triad, multiplying recruitment and collusion expense linearly with clone count.
